channels.name: registration
channels.note: Carries the exchange that registers a peer and establishes the cipher state for it. The request arrives before that state exists, so it is the one payload not enciphered as a whole, though a field inside it is.

channels.name: requests
channels.note: What a client sends to ask the server to act: orders, purchases, spell casts, and the answers to questions the server asked.

channels.name: clock
channels.note: Synchronisation of simulation time between the two ends.

channels.name: events
channels.note: The server's account of what happened, delivered whole. This is where most of what a client renders arrives.

channels.name: transient
channels.note: State that a following message supersedes, such as positions and unit properties. Losing one costs nothing where the next corrects it, which is what the messages recorded here are for.

channels.name: chat
channels.note: Text players send each other during a match. Messages between players outside a match do not travel on this connection at all.

channels.name: roster
channels.note: Team selection and the roster of who is in the match, while the match is being set up.
